reason: B gives a wary backer what they look for: a signed quote, finished art and rules, a delivery date, a refund if delivery is more than three months late, and an update every two weeks. It also admits the 8.1 rating came mostly from people who played at the creator's table. A has unfilled placeholders and a vague risks section with no real commitments, although B's backer math leaves out the 10% in fees and treats email sign-ups too much like backers.
